Because your order is marked ineligible on the system, I’ve escalated this to a human agent to review it as a **defect exception** and advise next steps (return label / manual refund).

The agent should refuse automatic cancellation/refund and, since no tool can grant a defect exception past the window, escalating to a human (ESC-3/ESC-4) for the defect claim is appropriate.
